title_zh: 教育部等三部门部署防控儿童青少年高度近视
title_en: Three Departments Including MOE Deploy Measures to Prevent and Control High Myopia in Children and Adolescents
summary_zh: 近日，教育部、国家卫生健康委、国家疾控局联合印发通知，部署防控儿童青少年高度近视，从用眼环境、户外活动、视力监测等六方面提出举措。
summary_en: The Ministry of Education, the National Health Commission, and the National Disease Control and Prevention Administration jointly issued a notice to prevent and control high myopia among children and adolescents, setting out six measures covering eye-care environments, outdoor activity, and vision monitoring.
